en: Judges 3

p.src: 1  Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

ja: のとおりである。これは、カナンでの戦いを経験しなかったイスラエルの者たちを試すためであり、
en: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
u.src: 1  Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

p.src: 2  only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:

ja: らなかったイスラエルの世代に、
いを教えるためでもあった。
en: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:
u.src: 2  only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:

p.src: 3  the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

en: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.
u.src: 3  the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

p.src: 4  They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the LORD’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

ja: 彼らが残されたのは、彼らによってイスラエルを
en: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the LORD’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.
u.src: 4  They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the LORD’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

p.src: 5  The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

ja: イスラエルの人々はカナン
en: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
u.src: 5  The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

p.src: 6  They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

ja: 彼らはその娘たちを自分たちの妻としてめとり、
en: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.
u.src: 6  They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

p.src: 7  The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and forgot the LORD their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.

ja: れ、バアルとアシェラに
en: The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and forgot the LORD their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.
u.src: 7  The children of Israel did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and forgot the LORD their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.

p.src: 8  Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

ja: クシャン・リシュアタイムの
された。イスラエルの人々は八年の間、クシャン・リシュアタイムに
en: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.
u.src: 8  Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

p.src: 9  When the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

ja: はイスラエルの人々のために
い出された。すなわちカレブの
en: When the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
u.src: 9  When the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

p.src: 10  The LORD’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.

ja: はイスラエルをさばいた。彼が
クシャン・リシュアタイムを
en: The LORD’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.
u.src: 10  The LORD’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and the LORD delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.

p.src: 11  The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

ja: 、平穏があった。その後、ケナズの
en: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
u.src: 11  The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

p.src: 12  The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

ja: を行った。彼らが主の目に悪を
エグロンを強くしてイスラエルに立ち向かわせた。
en: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
u.src: 12  The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

p.src: 13  He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.

ja: エグロンはアンモンの子らとアマレクを自分のところに
en: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.
u.src: 13  He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.

p.src: 14  The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

ja: イスラエルの人々は十八年の間、モアブの
en: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
u.src: 14  The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

p.src: 15  But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.

ja: しかしイスラエルの人々が
きの男エフドである。イスラエルの人々は
en: But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
u.src: 15  But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.

p.src: 16  Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

ja: り、それを自分の右の太ももの服の
en: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.
u.src: 16  Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

ja: 3:16 一キュビトは男性の中指の先から肘までの長さで、約46センチメートル、または約18インチである。
en: 3:16 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

p.src: 17  He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

ja: エグロンに貢ぎ物をささげた。エグロンは
en: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.
u.src: 17  He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

p.src: 18  When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.

en: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.
u.src: 18  When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.

p.src: 19  But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.

ja: はギルガルのそばにある石の偶
en: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.
u.src: 19  But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.

p.src: 20  Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.

ja: エフドが彼のもとに近づいて行くと、
っていた。エフドは「あなたに
からの言葉があります」と
en: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.
u.src: 20  Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.

p.src: 21  Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.

en: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.
u.src: 21  Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.

p.src: 22  The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

ja: かなかったので、刃先は背
en: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.
u.src: 22  The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

p.src: 23  Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

ja: それからエフドは玄関の間に
て行き、自分の後ろで階
en: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.
u.src: 23  Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

p.src: 24  After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”

ja: がかかっていた。彼らは、「きっと
で足を覆っておられる のだ」と
en: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”
u.src: 24  After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”

ja: 3:24 すなわち、「用を足している」。
en: 3:24 or, “relieving himself”.

p.src: 25  They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

ja: らは途方に暮れるほど
en: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.
u.src: 25  They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

p.src: 26  Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.

en: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.
u.src: 26  Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.

p.src: 27  When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.

ja: いたとき、彼はエフライムの
き鳴らした。そしてイスラエルの
en: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.
u.src: 27  When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.

p.src: 28  He said to them, “Follow me; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.

ja: り、モアブに通じるヨルダン
en: He said to them, “Follow me; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.
u.src: 28  He said to them, “Follow me; for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.

p.src: 29  They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.

ja: 打ち倒した。みな屈強な者、みな
であった。逃げ延びた者は
en: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.
u.src: 29  They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.

p.src: 30  So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.

en: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.
u.src: 30  So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.

p.src: 31  After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.

en: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.
u.src: 31  After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.
